title: Reentrancy in withdraw
description: The withdraw function sends Ether before clearing the caller's balance, so a callback can re-enter withdraw and receive the same balance more than once.
impact: An attacker contract can withdraw more Ether than its recorded balance.
preconditions: The attacker has a positive recorded balance.
The attacker can receive Ether through a callback that calls withdraw again.
The Vault holds enough Ether to pay at least one reentrant withdrawal.
